# MM-P3-L3-SB01-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Machining shot blast cabinet #1

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01

Scope
- Visual and torque verification of accessible fasteners on Machining shot blast cabinet #1. Ensure mechanical integrity for safe operation and containment before return to production. Reference related documents SB-1010, SOP-P3-L3-04, SOP-P3-L3-05 for system-level requirements and isolation procedures.

Tools
- Hand tools and calibrated torque device as specified by maintenance stock and SOP-P3-L3-04.  
- Clean lint-free rags and approved solvent per SOP-P3-L3-05.  
- The lubricant part number for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is CFW-LUB-709.

Procedure
- Isolate cabinet per SOP-P3-L3-04 and verify lockout compliance in accordance with site procedures referenced in SB-1010.  
- Inspect external fasteners for corrosion, fretting, or loss of preload. Clean mating surfaces using approved solvent from tools list.  
- Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-709 to specified joints and fastener interfaces where lubrication is required by design. Reinstall or adjust fasteners to restore proper function. Use calibrated torque device to apply the specified torque values documented in equipment build records; record each fastener identifier and result on the maintenance record form that accompanies this document.  
- Reassemble guards and seals. Remove isolation and confirm system readiness per SOP-P3-L3-05.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible damage, seizure, or fretting at inspected fasteners. Fasteners retain design preload as verified by torque confirmation recorded in the maintenance record.  
- The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is 1590 Pa. Alarm status must be within allowable limits per SB-1010 before releasing equipment to operation.  
- Lubrication performed using part CFW-LUB-709 and documented on the job record. Related procedures and isolation steps completed and cited: SB-1010, SOP-P3-L3-04, SOP-P3-L3-05.
